newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah easier amid liquidity, earthquake.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah easier amid liquidity, earthquake.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah weakened against the dollar in late trading on Monday amid continued ample liquidity in trading marred by panic over an earthquake, dealers said.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,403.50/04.00 at 0930 GMT compared with an opening of 2,400.75/401.50.

"Short-term liquidity remained flush and is likely to stay so until a few days before April 1, when banks are required to meet the new minimum reserve requirements of five percent," one foreign bank dealer said. The current requirement is three percent.
